title: Angular
description: Native standalone Angular components, signals and Angular Forms from minerva-design/angular.
scope: The native Angular package is available. Implemented components and platform differences are listed in the support matrix.

setup.title: Setup
setup.text: Install minerva-design and the Angular peer versions declared by the package. Import the shared stylesheet once and bootstrap provideMinerva for theme and locale.

signals.title: Signals and native imports
signals.text: Import standalone directives and components directly. MnButton enhances a native button; MnInput and MnUpload expose typed value models. CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA is not needed.

forms.title: Angular Forms
forms.text: The native input and upload components include ControlValueAccessor support. Use ReactiveFormsModule or FormsModule directly; no custom value-accessor directive is required. Disabled, touched and value updates participate in the Angular form.

upload: Upload selects and validates local files. The application handles network transfers: listen to filesSelected and update each UploadItem status as the transfer progresses.
preview: Every component-page Angular tab runs native standalone Angular components with interactive inputs and outputs. Examples are compiled ahead of time with strict template checks; the displayed source matches the live preview. The separate Web Components guide remains available for custom-element integration.
